regions.region: page 2 title, author block, abstract, and ESI footnote
regions.finding: Verified the source title 'Suzuki coupling for preparation of allenes-ligand effect and chirality transfer'. The page states ESI availability, but workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
Generic 60–100 °C palladium/organoboron couplings are explicitly prior-work context and are classified as a literature example, not current-paper experiments.
Generic current Pd2(dba)3·CHCl3/L3 coupling at room temperature or 30 °C is a general scheme; experiment-specific rows are recorded from later pages.
Background, motivation, and aggregate method claim only; no additional uniquely specified current experiment is created from prose.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 substituents and optional prior-work conditions do not define unique structures or yields.

regions.finding: Sixteen displayed ligand conditions were read row-by-row: fifteen stand-alone Scheme 2 conditions plus the L3 condition merged with Table 1 entry 4. The records retain 8 mol% monophosphine or 4.2 mol% bisphosphine, 30 °C/12 h, NMR yield or complicated outcome, and parenthesized recovery of 1a.

regions.region: page 3 lower Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–12, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Twelve independent optimization rows were retained with row palladium source, solvent, boron reagent, footnote amounts, argon, time/temperature, NMR yield, isolated yield where printed, and substrate recovery. Dashes remain source markers; entry 12 retains its 1 mmol/2 mL override without invented exact scaled charges.
Narrative ligand and palladium observations map to Scheme 2/Table 1 records rather than duplicate experiments. The prose/table trace-versus-5% issue for [Pd(allyl)Cl]2 is preserved unresolved.

unresolved: Scheme 2 lacks scale, atmosphere, workup, purification, and masses.
Table 1 entry 3 is described as trace in prose but gives 5% in the table.
Entry 12 does not print exact scaled mmol charges for boron reagent, palladium source, or L3.

regions.region: page 4 Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–24, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Twenty-four independent substrate-scope rows were retained with shared exact conditions and row-specific 18 h, 40 °C, 2.5 mmol boronic-acid, 10 mmol scale, and <5% residual-starting-material footnotes. All yields are isolated; entry 13 is a distinct gram-scale repeat.
Functional-group and steric-effect discussion maps to the corresponding Table 2 rows and adds no duplicate experiments.

unresolved: Workups, purifications, isolated masses, and residual-starting-material detection limits are not reported on pages 1–6.
The 10 mmol row does not explicitly restate all absolute charges.

regions.finding: Four distinct tertiary-carbonate couplings were retained with row boronic-acid equivalents, 30 or 70 °C, 12 h, isolated yields, and the printed 90% product purity for 3nl.

The first coupling to unstable triene 5 (74% NMR yield) and the subsequent N-methylmaleimide cycloaddition were split into separate stages. The 70% value is retained as a two-step yield from 1a to 6, not a second-stage yield.
Two stability/racemization controls of (S)-3pj were retained separately: no-Pd and Pd2(dba)3·CHCl3/L3 conditions, each with recovered amount and post-treatment e.r.

Four distinct water-assisted 30 min stereospecific couplings were retained with starting/product e.r. and isolated yield. Figure 1 is ORTEP characterization of (S)-3qj, not another preparation or machine-structure verification.

unresolved: Scheme 3/4/5 omit most scales, absolute charges, workups, purifications, masses, and several analytical bases.
The cycloaddition-stage yield alone is unknown.
Compact tri-/tetrasubstituted and chiral structures remain label-only where encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 6 upper Table 3 reaction header, entries 1–5, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Five independent heteroarylboronic-acid experiments were retained with exact charges, 12/24 h, isolated yields, water explicitly absent from entries 1–3, and row-specific starting-material recoveries.
Four L4–L7 ligand-control experiments were retained. L4/L5 have separate NMR yield and recovery outcomes; L6/L7 are failed reactions with 95%/90% recovery, not zero-yield assumptions.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left Scheme 7 and adjacent mechanism prose
